tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gur gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma la brten pa'i bsnyen pa'i kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi tho bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ye/ gur mgon gyi srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i bsnyen pa rdzogs nas sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang / lhag chad kha skong ba dang / dam tshig nyams pa skong ba dang / sdig pa dang nad gdon zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ zhi ba'i thabs kyai rdor ltar las/ nang du rdo rje brag rdzong dmar nag mtshon byed gru gsum dmar po rtse mo phyir bstan dang / de'i steng du gru gsum nag po rtse phyir bstan pa/ de'i nang du khrag zhag tshon byed dmar po dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu pa'am brgyad pa bri/ bcad rnams gang mdzes bya/ 'khor lo'i lte ba dang rtsibs rnams la pad nyi'i steng du tshon dpung nag po re bya/ de yang steng gi de shar gyi g.yas dang / 'og gi de nub kyi g.yon du bkod/ chos 'byung 'khor lo sogs ma grub na tshom bu bcu gcig sngar ltar bkod pas rung / bri bya la de ltar mdzad/ sgom don la steng 'og gi rtsibs dang lha steng 'og rnams rang sar yong / yam shing sogs bsreg rdzas rnams dang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa dang gtor ma gnyis sogs bshams tshul kyai rdor dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi ni mgon po brag rdzong ma'i bdag bskyed bya/ nang mchod kyai rdor ltar byin gyis brlabs la bzhag me sbar ba sogs de wa pi tsu'i tshab tu yi ge bdun ma brjod de/ oṃ dz+wa la sogs 'dra/ bsang chu nas/ bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas byin rlabs kyang gzhan 'dra/ oṃ ni ri sogs chu bzhi'i sngags dor te/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs brjod/ thab kyi bskyed chog dang / 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod chu bzhi dang dkar mo ri dwags sogs mi dgos pa ni/ swa bhā wa sogs nas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur ba bsam mo'i bar 'dra'o/

/'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su suṃ las rdo rje'i brag rdzong zhes pa nas mi bskyod pa re re dbu brgyan pa'i bar mgon po khro bo bcu gcig bskyed/ lha rnams 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sogs kyis dmigs pa gsal btab/ hūm̐ brjod cing bsang chu gtor ba 'dra dgang blugs blangs te dmigs pa dang bcas pas yi ge bdun ma lan 'ga' zhig brjod de/ oṃ ag+na ye sogs kyis byon skyems lan gsum 'bul ba 'dra/ oṃ shrī mā kā la sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shap+ta'i bar dharmā ra ṇis rol chen phyi mchod mtshan sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod/ rdor dril dang / mgon po'i bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar yi ge bdun ma gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang / mjug tu spel tshig sbyor tshul sogs 'dra/ bsnyen pa ci tsam song ba'i bcu cha yi ge bdun ma 'ba' zhig gis nub re bzhin til khri phrag mang du 'bul te/ de yang bsnyen pa 'bum tsho bdun song na khri tsho bdun/ 'bum tsho bcu drug song na khri tsho bcu drug 'bum tsho drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa song na khri khrag drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa dgos so/ /sgrub g.yog gis me rgyun ma chad pa dang / zhu ba'i rdzas lha thams cad kyi zhal du sogs kyi dmigs pa 'dra/ de nas byon skyems ltar mar dag gang blugs gsum gyis gshegs skyems 'bul/ gtor ma kyai rdor ltar byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi sho mu khe sogs lan bdun dang / shā sa na lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ mgon po thugs rje chen po sogs kyis 'dod don zhus/ yi ge brgya pa sogs nas rang la thim par bsam mo'i bar 'dra/ gsum pa rjes la me lha lhag mas mchod sogs nas bkra shis bya'i bar 'dra/

'on kyang 'jig rten pa'i me lha la'ang oṃ ni ri sogs chu bzhi dor/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra yar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs mi dgos so/ /'di ni kyai rdo rje'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa gsal ba'i me long gzhir bzhag byas nas mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyi tho tsam bkod pa'i/ de ltar bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas kha bskong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'di bzhin sngon du song nas rang gzhan gyis mi mthun phyogs dang / bstan 'gro'i 'gal rkyen tshar gcod pa drag po'i sbyin sreg ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha logs na yod pa ltar bya'o/ /'di ni don gnyer du mas bskul ba la brten nas snyoms las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis e waṃ dgon par myur bar bris pa'o/ /'dis don gnyer sgrub pa po rnams la phan par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ dpal gur gyi mgon po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi tho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
